_faq.q: What does the Valentine's package include?
_faq.a: A night in a Deluxe room with its own infrared sauna, romantically decorated and with a loving surprise. In the evening a 3-course tasting menu at Restaurant Asteria with a glass of prosecco, the next morning an extensive breakfast buffet and late check-out until 13.00 (subject to availability). Parking is free.
The Valentine's package is for Valentine's weekend: arrival on Saturday 13 or Sunday 14 February 2027, for one night. The promo code VALENTIJN is already filled in for you.

_faq.q: How much does the package cost?
_faq.a: In the Deluxe room you pay € 255.00 per room for 2 people and 1 night. The Suite costs € 20 more per night, the Bridal suite € 50. Tourist tax of € 2.00 per person per night is added. Book directly with us and you pay no booking fees.

_faq.q: Can I cancel free of charge?
_faq.a: Yes, you can cancel free of charge up to 14 days before arrival.

_faq.q: Can I use the wellness area?
_faq.a: The wellness area on the Top Floor is not included in the package. You can add it at reception during your stay. Your Deluxe room has its own infrared sauna.

_faq.q: Can I park at the hotel?
_faq.a: Yes, parking at the hotel is free.

BANEN_INTRO: The package is in a Deluxe room. Would you like more space or a freestanding bath? Choose the Suite or the Bridal suite when you book, for a supplement.

_banen.tekst: Our most spacious room, with its own infrared sauna and a generous seating area.

_banen.tekst: A freestanding bath and a spacious walk-in shower. No sauna, but all the time in the world for a long soak.
